name: smwmusic-koyaanisqatsi-clouds
title: Koyaanisqatsi - Clouds
description:
A somewhat aerian track featured in the movie at a moment where vast nature sceneries are seen. Useful for credits or sky levels, retry patch is recommended to go along with the song's length.

The track is either called Clouds or Cloudscape, I went for the shorter name.

This track was featured for the Winter C3 of 2022.

The arrangement is by musescore user Fugue Troll.
